policy.modelSize: Not reported

benchmarkSummary: A controlled world-model planning study over 12 contact-rich manipulation tasks, comparing visual geometry and tactile channels.
policySummary: A JEPA-style latent world model learns visuo-tactile dynamics from demonstrations and supplies a goal-conditioned CEM planner with receding-horizon control.

policy.baseModel: From-scratch IMPALA-style RGB/tactile-image encoders, PointNet-style point-cloud encoder or taxel-wise TacFF MLP; latent concatenation and action-conditioned GRU dynamics with JEPA-style prediction.
policy.modelSize: Representation-dependent; Figure 7 visualizes model sizes with example bubble labels 1.6M, 5.4M and 17.9M. There is no single universal ContactWorld policy size.
policy.inputs: Current and goal sensory observations: wrist/front RGB or front RGB-D-derived XYZRGB point cloud, optionally paired with TacRGB, TacDepth or normal/tangential TacFF. Combinations are separately evaluated; no language instruction input.
policy.outputs: Relative Cartesian end-effector actions: 6D pose for insertion with fixed gripper, plus scalar gripper command for other categories. CEM plans 6 steps and executes only the first action before replanning.
policy.trainingData: Simulation: 1872 demonstrations, 247518 interaction steps at 10 Hz. Physical: 80 demos per each of 6 tasks, split into 50 training and 30 held-out evaluation demos per task.
policy.trainingTime: Wall-clock duration not reported. Simulation: 100K gradient updates, batch 64. Physical: 200 epochs with the final checkpoint and no task-specific checkpoint selection.
policy.controlRate: Closed-loop environment/task-space control at 10 Hz. Model planning-frequency comparisons are a distinct profiling measurement, not the low-level robot servo rate.
policy.trainingMethod: Learn all encoders/dynamics from scratch using latent prediction, temporal similarity, inverse dynamics and VICReg-style regularization. Plan with CEM: 100 candidates, 4 optimization iterations and 8 elites, minimizing terminal latent-goal distance.
policy.evaluation: 12 contact-rich simulated variants with goal offsets 12/24/36/48 and 100 rollouts per setting; 6 physical tasks across 2 robot platforms and 3 tactile sensing systems, totaling 900 trials.
